summary: Microsoft's own sign-in can now protect the web app, so every visitor signs in with Microsoft Entra before reaching SecurityInsight.

new.title: Microsoft's built-in sign-in for the web app
new.text: The web app can sit behind Microsoft's own sign-in. Visitors sign in with Microsoft Entra before anything else, your Conditional Access applies, and no password or secret is stored. Your support partner turns it on per installation.

fixes.title: Group access works with the new sign-in
fixes.text: With Microsoft's sign-in, SecurityInsight reads each person's groups itself, so access given to a group keeps working.
